ValidationRule.description:
When the 'AFCA Registration Category' is updated to 'Post IDR Referral'
Then the EDR Impact on IDR outcome should become a mandatory field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), (TEXT(IDR_AFCA_Status__c) = '11'), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_AFCA_EDR_impact__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: EDR impact on IDR outcome is Required
